req.title: Reject limit above cap
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the limit parameter exceeds the maximum allowed.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the 'limit' parameter exceeds the maximum allowed value. This behavior ensures that the API enforces constraints on input parameters, preventing excessive data requests that could degrade performance or cause errors. The test suite includes a positive case to verify normal operation within limits, a negative case to check the response when the limit is exceeded, and a boundary case to test the exact limit value.

tests.name: test_read_tasks_within_limit
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with limit=100.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=100')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) <= 100

tests.name: test_read_tasks_limit_exceeds_cap
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with limit=1001.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/?limit=1001')
assert response.status_code == 422
